name: android emulator smoke
comment: Synchronises on what is on screen rather than on fixed waits. A software-rendered emulator is slow and its timing varies run to run, so a sleep long enough today is not long enough tomorrow.

steps.name: it is the emulator, not a stray device
tap an app icon by its label
steps.comment: By label, not coordinates: uiautomator knows where it is, so this survives a change of device or resolution.

steps.name: the tap really launched it
steps.comment: Read the resumed activity off the device rather than trusting the screenshot.
steps.exec: for i in $(seq 1 30); do dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 -iE 'ResumedActivity' | grep -i messaging && break; sleep 2; done

steps.name: wait for the home screen again
tap the search box by its label
steps.comment: The label is a plain text node; the tap lands on the control wrapping it. 'Back' only exists once the search screen is up, so the tap is retried until it is.

steps.name: the typing really reached the field
steps.comment: Clear text only exists once a search field has content. Asserted immediately: the search module is unstable on an emulator without Play services.

steps.name: and the field holds the query
